feature: Reopen a versioned state-table TXT, review source changes, update the ordinary draft and Save the same file.

sourceEnvelope.layout: Short comment title, declaration comment line, unchanged v1 body.

limitations: Actual Chrome with local HTTP editor and a trusted Godot binary. No installed Tauri window, native picker, Android or other desktop OS claim.

A disposable fixture prepares scenes, clips and a bound state-table controller. Actual GUI changes its event transitions, applies a draft, saves the same TXT and runs that newly saved source. OC creation and initial binding are fixture setup, not GUI coverage.
Native Godot headless logic and browser receipt display are tested. No installed Tauri, Android, native window rendering or delivered game execution claim.
No automatic migration of behavior parameter keys after state rename/removal.
No arbitrary GDScript reverse parsing or legacy unmarked source adoption.
One scene-wide playhead; no new per-instance animation, conditions, mixing or Bevy animation.
